name: Pipofezine
summary: Pipofezine, sold under the brand name Azafen or Azaphen, is a tricyclic antidepressant approved in Russia for the treatment of depression. It was introduced in the late 1960s and is still used today.

pharmacology.text: Pipofezine has been shown to act as a potent inhibitor of the reuptake of serotonin.

uses.text: Pipofezine, sold under the brand name Azafen or Azaphen, is a tricyclic antidepressant approved in Russia for the treatment of depression. It was introduced in the late 1960s and is still used today.

sideEffects.en: Reported effects include drowsiness, dry mouth, dizziness, nausea and sweating. Because it strongly raises serotonin, it carries a risk of serotonin syndrome, and overdose of tricyclic antidepressants can be dangerous to the heart.
sideEffects.zh: 已知的副作用包括嗜睡、口乾、頭暈、噁心和出汗。由於它會大幅提高血清素，有引發血清素症候群的風險，而三環抗憂鬱藥過量可能對心臟造成危險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 已知的副作用包括嗜睡、口干、头晕、恶心和出汗。由于它会大幅提高血清素，有引发血清素症候群的风险，而三环抗忧郁药过量可能对心脏造成危险。

fact.en: Pipofezine was developed in the Soviet Union and is one of several antidepressants that are well known in Russia but were never sold in Western Europe or North America.
fact.zh: Pipofezine 是在蘇聯開發的，屬於在俄羅斯廣為人知、卻從未在西歐或北美上市的幾種抗憂鬱藥之一。
fact.zhHans: Pipofezine 是在苏联开发的，属于在俄罗斯广为人知、却从未在西欧或北美上市的几种抗忧郁药之一。
